symptoms: Angular, water-soaked leaf spots that turn brown-black with age
Black vein streaks along the leaf veins
Black arm: dark lesions on stems and branches
Boll rot with sunken dark patches, lint staining

severity_cues.advanced: Vein streaks, stem lesions (black arm), boll rot and lint staining

favorable_conditions: Warm (28 to 35 C) wet weather, wind-driven rain, dense canopy, infected seed lots

treatment.summary: Suppress with copper plus streptocycline sprays and stop it spreading by sanitation, since bactericides suppress but do not cure
steps: Spray Copper oxychloride 50 WP at 3.0 g per litre plus Streptocycline at 0.05 g per litre
Repeat every 10 days while wet weather continues
Collect and destroy infected plant debris, do not reuse the same field seed
For next season: use certified disease-free or acid-delinted seed

products.name: Copper oxychloride 50 WP
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 7 days

products.name: Streptocycline (streptomycin sulphate plus tetracycline hydrochloride)
products.label_source: State agriculture advisory, 0.5 g per 10 litres

organic: Seed treatment with hot water before sowing
Crop rotation out of cotton and clean residue destruction

source.org: ICAR Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR), cotton disease advisory
source.title: Cotton: bacterial blight management

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Do not pick cotton within 7 days of spray
